probes.name: erl_unnumbered
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
On Error Resume Next
Dim x As Long
x = 1 / 0
Probe = Erl & "|" & Err.Number
End Function

probes.name: erl_after_unnumbered
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
On Error Resume Next
10 Dim x As Long
x = 1 / 0
Probe = Erl
End Function

probes.name: erl_handler
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
On Error GoTo h
100 Dim y As Long
110 y = 1
120 Err.Raise 5
Exit Function
h:
Probe = Erl
End Function

probes.name: erl_after_clear
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
On Error Resume Next
10 Err.Raise 5
Err.Clear
Probe = Erl
End Function

probes.name: erl_no_error
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
10 Dim x As Long
20 x = 1
Probe = Erl
End Function

probes.name: erl_label_with_colon
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
On Error Resume Next
40: Err.Raise 5
Probe = Erl
End Function

probes.name: erl_after_executable_line
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
On Error Resume Next
10 Dim x As Long
15 x = 5
